UPPSC LT Grade Assistant Teacher Mains Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the mains Result for the post of Assistant Teacher (TGT). This recruitment was released for 7466 posts. Applications for the UP LT Grade Assistant Teacher Mains Recruitment 2026 were accepted from April 02, 2026, to April 17, 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 13 June 2026 and 11 July 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UP LT Grade Assistant Teacher Mains Result 2026 from the link given below.
